changeSet.comment: Convert every non-user entity identifier from BIGINT to deterministic UUID values while leaving users.id and user foreign keys unchanged.

changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Convert Hibernate-generated collection-table join columns to UUID.
changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE column_record RECORD; BEGIN FOR column_record IN SELECT table_name, column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND data_type IN ('bigint', 'integer') AND table_name <> 'users' AND (column_name LIKE '%house_id' OR column_name LIKE '%room_id') LOOP EXECUTE format( 'ALTER TABLE %I ALTER COLUMN %I TYPE UUID USING md5(%I::text)::uuid', column_record.table_name, column_record.column_name, column_record.column_name); END LOOP; END $$;
